project_comments.note: Cross-cutting observation: This cycle successfully closed all 5 deferred items from the prior synthesis with zero blocking failures and only 1 rework cycle (WP-001 AC-2 literal vs. collection-fixture interpretation). The dual-mechanism xUnit pattern (IClassFixture + DisableParallelization collection) and locale-agnostic assertion discipline are now documented and should be enforced as project standards for any future test additions touching LocalizationService. Three Debug.Assert gaps remain in DiffService.cs Steps 2, 3, and 4 (deferred items D-01, D-02, D-03) — these should be the first items seeded into the next plan cycle.

outcome_summary: All 5 deferred items from the prior LCS diff pipeline synthesis were promoted and completed: 21 locale-dependent test failures were eliminated via EnglishLocaleFixture + LocaleSequentialCollection; 10 ClassifyChanges isolation tests (Steps 9a–9j) were added with structural-property-only assertions; Debug.Assert guards were inserted at three LineNumber/ReferenceNumber invariant sites and a vacuous .Where filter was removed; the O(n²) Step 6b insertion attribution LINQ was replaced with an amortized O(k) two-pointer scan; and ~130 lines of stale historical simulation were removed from ReplacementDetectionDiagnostics.cs. The test suite stands at 439/440 pass, with the single remaining failure being a pre-existing file-encoding bug out of scope for this plan.
project_summary: This rework plan addresses all actionable deferred items from the initial LCS diff pipeline synthesis. It fixes 21 pre-existing locale-dependent test failures by introducing an EnglishLocaleFixture, adds dedicated ClassifyChanges isolation tests covering every classification step, cleans up internal code inconsistencies (null-LineNumber fallback alignment and vacuous filter removal), optimizes the O(n²) insertion attribution LINQ to linear time, and removes stale historical simulation code from ReplacementDetectionDiagnostics.
